[P1] Mary Washington
Mary Washington may refer to : Mary L. Washington , Maryland legislator Mary Ball Washington ( 1708 -- 1789 ) , mother of U.S. President George Washington University of Mary Washington

[P2] Mary Ball Washington
Mary Ball Washington , born Mary Ball ( November 30 , 1708 -- August 26 , 1789 ) , was the second wife of Augustine Washington , a planter in Virginia , and the mother of George Washington , the first President of the United States , and five other children .

[P3] Lewis Washington
Lewis William Washington ( November 30 , 1812 - October 1 , 1871 ) was a great-grandnephew of President George Washington , who is principally remembered as a hostage of abolitionist John Brown 's raid on Harpers Ferry , Virginia and as a prosecution witness in the subsequent trial of Brown . Lewis Washington was the son of George Corbin Washington , the grandson of William Augustine Washington , and a great-grandson of Augustine Washington , half-brother of George Washington . Lewis Washington inherited Bel-Air near Halltown , West Virginia through his mother , Elizabeth , daughter of Thomas Beall . He made his home at Bel - Air from 1840 until his death in 1871 .

[P4] Mary Washington House
The Mary Washington House , at 1200 Charles Street in Fredericksburg , Virginia , is the house in which George Washington 's mother , Mary Ball Washington , resided towards the end of her life . It is now operated as an 18th-century period historic house museum , one of several museums in Fredericksburg operated by Washington Heritage Museums .

[P5] St. Mary's, Whitechapel
St Mary 's Whitechapel is an Episcopal church in Lancaster , Virginia , founded in 1669 , and located three miles south of Lively , in Lancaster County , in the Northern Neck . The parish of St Mary 's Whitechapel is notable for being the birthplace of Mary Ball Washington , mother of George Washington .
